sanjay: Heads-up — I'll start the v2-routing production deploy in ~10m (deploy/2026-03-17-rtg2). Plan: canary 10% for 15m -> 50% -> full. Need quick owners for smoke checks, metrics watch, and rollback readiness. My quick runbook below.

Maria C: on it, I can run the e2e paths + health endpoints, will post results.

Eli W: I'll pull DB + cache metrics, and watch shard latencies. Prometheus: https://prometheus.redwood.internal/graph?g0.expr=job%3D%22routing%22

Jess: I will keep the Console SLO dashboard open and alert if error rate > 0.5% or p50 spike > 50ms.

deploy-bot: deploy/2026-03-17-rtg2: canary start — 10% (10 instances). Status: in_progress :rocket:

Tim: quick Q — rollback plan? automated thresholds or manual?

Maria C: rollback options: prefer `rdeploy rollback --id deploy/2026-03-17-rtg2` (our deploy tool). Manual fallback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/routing -n prod`. Ops will be on-call if needed.

sanjay: Decision: automated rollback if any of these sustained for 3m: error_rate > 1% OR p95 latency > 500ms OR failed canary health checks. Manual rollback allowed for owners.

Eli W: smoke checklist (I'll run these immediately):
```
- curl -sS https://prod.api.redwood.com/routing/health | jq .status  # expect "ok"
- curl -sS 'https://prod.api.redwood.com/routing/route?from=A&to=B' | jq .latency  # < 200ms
- prometheus: request rate and 5m error rate for routing job
- redis: check cache hit rate (expect > 88%)
- db: check p99 query time for routing lookup
```

Maria C: e2e smoke start — running the path test now.

deploy-bot: canary progress: 10% -> healthy checks passing (3/3 health probes).

Maria C: e2e path tests: PASS (10 sample paths, no errors). Latency avg 120ms.

Jess: Console check: error rate 0.12% (stable), p50 +10ms, p95 +20ms — within SLOs.

Eli W: Cache hit-rate: dropped 2.1% vs baseline, current 90.4% — within tolerance but I will keep watching. DB p99 = 210ms (baseline 200ms).

Tim: ack — standing by for rollback if needed.

sanjay: Ok moving to 50% now. Leaving this thread for live notes. If anything crosses thresholds, @here and we'll execute rollback. Thanks all :thumbsup:
